intro: The Jack table brings strength, style, and warmth to your dining space. Its bold L-shaped legs and premium wood finish set the stage for meals, memories, and moments that matter.

features.title: Premium top for a polished look
features.text: The MDF tabletop with okoume veneer brings a high-end look that’s both stylish and visually appealing.

features.title: Sturdy wood legs for support
features.text: A foundation built to last. Solid wood L-shaped legs provide stability while giving your space a unique design statement.

features.title: Rich colour for added elegance
features.text: The brownish-black finish adds a refined touch that pairs beautifully with a variety of interior styles.

features.title: Everyday strength you can trust
features.text: Built for everyday moments—the 19 mm thick tabletop ensures durability for meals, crafts, and family gatherings.

features.title: Perfect for family dining
features.text: Comfortably seat six guests—this rectangular table provides plenty of space for family meals and get-togethers.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Jack 6-Seater Engineered Wood Rectangular Dining Table
